handoffs.message: Implementation complete: PR #2993 closes the cron-turn -> persisted OODA packet gap via Option B (Pantheon-side observer). cron_transport.py gained reusable force_run_job()/_poll_for_terminal_run()/_select_run() helpers; new services/persona/cron_ooda_closure.py force-runs an already-registered persona cron job, drives one real synchronous OpenClaw agent turn, and persists an OodaLoopPacket carrying the real cron run_id/job_id fingerprint (fail-closed if the cron run does not reach status ok; honestly stays at 'observing' with an agent-turn-unavailable audit ref if the live agent turn errors/empty, never fabricates forward). New scripts/openclaw-close-persona-cron-ooda.py ops CLI, 7 unit tests (fake gateway), and a live smoke test that skips explicitly without a live gateway. pytest services/control-plane/cron, services/control-plane/ooda, services/persona/test_cron_ooda_closure.py -> 91 passed. Live smoke run against local gateway/adapter stack: forced persona-tw-equity's cron job, cron.runs status ok with real run id, real (non-fabricated) agent decision, packet round-tripped through BFF ServiceBackedReadAdapter with matching cron_run_id fingerprint; also verified /bff/ooda/packets count 0->1 in the live dev BFF container using a produced packet, then cleaned up. PR is CLEAN/mergeable, all 3 required checks green, just refreshed against latest dev. Please review PR https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2993.
